title: Bug: test_update_saithrift_ptf fails on multi-asic devices
author: yejianquan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

Bug: test_update_saithrift_ptf fails on multi-asic devices

A bug is introduced in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/19528
it executes on container 'syncd', but in multi-asic devices, it will be 'syncd0, syncd1 ...'

### Steps to Reproduce

Run pretest on multi-asic devices

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

No failure
